title: The CIA showed Elizondo MRIs of UAP witnesses with caudate putamen differences

tellings.quote: from my point of view when I got involved the CIA came to my office and then they showed me MRIs of some of these people and most of those people had interactions with UFOs

plain: The CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, is said to have shown brain scans (MRIs) of people who had run-ins with UFOs, also called UAP or unidentified anomalous phenomena, and these scans showed differences in the caudate putamen, a region deep in the brain. The account comes up in Michels's documentary about Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, and is attributed to Garry Nolan, listed as a witness, who says first-hand that "the CIA came to my office and then they showed me MRIs of some of these people and most of those people had interactions with UFOs." If true, it would mean these encounters leave a mark on the brain.
